Scaffold a hardened Kubernetes CronJob for this project's syncs.

## Usage

```bash
drt deploy k8s-cronjob [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--schedule`, `-s` | `TEXT` |  | Required 5-field cron schedule, e.g. "40 3 * * *". |
| `--select` | `TEXT` | `*` | One sync selector passed to drt run. |
| `--image` | `TEXT` | `YOUR_REGISTRY/drt-sync:latest` | Container image for the CronJob. |
| `--secret-name` | `TEXT` | `drt-secrets` | Kubernetes Secret containing runtime env vars. |
| `--output`, `-o` | `PATH` | `deploy/k8s-cronjob.yml` | CronJob manifest path to write. |
| `--dry-run` | `BOOLEAN` |  | Print the manifest instead of writing it. |
| `--force` | `BOOLEAN` |  | Overwrite an existing manifest. |
